Christa was born and raised in San Gabriel, California and received her Bachelor of Arts degree in Television, Film and Media Studies at Cal State LA. She joined the insurance industry in 2012 and obtained her CISR designation in 2014. Christa is experienced in many areas of insurance, and especially enjoys working with nonprofit organizations.

Christa enjoys spending time outdoors with her family, especially camping and hiking. Christa and her family recently welcomed a new four-legged family member, their puppy Mika!
